name: Yiff Strip Holiday (EP4)
source:
Yiff Strip Holiday is an adult furry stripping game, in a fast-paced clicking environment. The better your clicking timing, the greater your reward!

The fourth of a series of games by Furry Outpost. Unlike our earlier games where you'd answer trivia, this game is based on focus and timing! You'll want to click on clothing or present icons, and you'll want to avoid coal icons! If you click three coals, it's game over! If you get through all six rounds, you'll be rewarded with a sexy and naked Natalie! Bonus presents
